name: sol-advisor
description: Quality-first Codex workflow with optional bounded delegation, project opt-out, isolated primary context, and weighted quota routing.

interface.shortDescription: Quality-first delegation for context and quota efficiency.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor makes bounded delegation globally eligible unless the current workspace opts out, without requiring a child or route record. It routes six functional custom agents only when delegation preserves task accuracy and completion while materially improving primary-context isolation, weighted quota cost, or independent verification. Spark handles compact frozen local production; GPT-5.6 roles handle investigation, synthesis, repeated mechanical transformations, risk-selected verification, and genuine adjudication. The primary session owns direct tool lookups, design-dependent implementation, bounded evidence checks, fallback, and final integration.
defaultPrompt: Preserve task accuracy and completion before considering delegation.
Consider a bounded child only when it materially improves primary-context isolation, weighted quota cost, or independent verification.
Use zero children when direct tools suffice or delegation benefit is unclear.
Keep design-dependent implementation primary; read one native final result, allow one targeted correction with the same model and effort, then fall back.
